name: Calm
one_liner: Calm is a leading meditation and sleep app offering guided meditations, sleep stories, breathing exercises, and relaxing music for stress reduction and better sleep.
best_for: People wanting a polished, curated meditation experience
Those struggling with sleep who want sleep stories and sounds
People new to meditation who want guided programs
Those who enjoy celebrity-narrated content and high production value
People willing to pay for a premium wellness experience
not_for: Those on a tight budget (limited free content)
People wanting free unlimited meditation (try Insight Timer)
Those looking for clinical anxiety or trauma treatment
short_description: Premium meditation and sleep app with guided programs, sleep stories, and relaxing soundscapes.
long_description: Calm is one of the most popular meditation apps, known for its high production quality, celebrity sleep stories, and curated content. The app includes guided meditation programs for stress, anxiety, focus, and more, plus extensive sleep content including stories, music, and soundscapes. Calm offers daily meditations, masterclasses, and mood-specific content. While some content is free, full access requires a subscription.
patient_summary: Calm helps you relax, meditate, and sleep better. Listen to sleep stories, follow guided meditations, or just play calming sounds. It's polished and easy to use, great for beginners.

pricing.notes: Limited free content. Full access requires $69.99/year or $14.99/month subscription.

privacy.notes: Standard wellness app privacy practices. Data used for personalization.

faqs.q: Is Calm worth the subscription cost?
faqs.a: Calm's value depends on your usage. If you use it daily for sleep or meditation, the $70/year ($5.80/month) can be worthwhile. If you just want occasional meditation, free apps like Insight Timer might be better value.

faqs.q: How is Calm different from Headspace?
faqs.a: Both are premium meditation apps. Calm emphasizes sleep content and celebrity sleep stories. Headspace emphasizes structured meditation courses and mindfulness education. Many people try both and choose based on style preference.
Calm is one of the best apps for sleep. Sleep Stories (bedtime stories for adults) are particularly popular. The app also offers sleep meditations, sleep music, and soundscapes.

Calm can help with stress and mild anxiety through meditation and breathing exercises. It's not a treatment for anxiety disorders but can be a helpful self-care tool alongside professional treatment if needed.
